2116523233184710738.en_summary: (Reposted by @Austan_Goolsbee) Today I mourn the loss of a great person and economist. Jim Andreoni has been a friend and mentor since the early 1990s. Jim was a Wisconsin kid through and through. Big heart, always friendly and wise, and one of the most caring people you will ever meet. Professionally, Jim inspired us all across areas as diverse as charitable giving and GARP. We lost an intellectual giant today but more importantly we lost a great human being.
2116523233184710738.zh_summary: （由 @Austan_Goolsbee 轉貼）今天我哀悼一位偉大人物兼經濟學家的離世。Jim Andreoni 自 1990 年代初起就是朋友與導師。Jim 是徹頭徹尾的威斯康星人。心胸寬廣，總是友善且睿智，是你遇過最有愛心的人之一。專業上，Jim 在慈善捐贈與 GARP 等多元領域啟發了我們所有人。我們今天失去了一位智慧巨人，但更重要的是失去了一位偉大的人。
